zh.summary: 把 Open、Closed、Filtered 與其他狀態連回觀察位置、方法及回應，選擇下一步查核。

sourceBody.text: CEH M03-04｜Open、Closed、Filtered：從回應讀懂連接埠狀態
連接埠掃描（Port Scanning）透過探測與回應，判讀一個通訊入口在當時呈現的狀態。先記住：open 有接受通訊的證據；closed 有明確的關閉回應；filtered 表示這種探測無法確認入口是否開放。實際分類還要看掃描方法。
M03-01 認識 IP、TCP、UDP 與 Port；M03-02 探索主機並解讀 ICMP、ARP；M03-03 比較 Connect、SYN、UDP 掃描。這一課把結果串成「方法 → 回應 → 狀態 → 查核 → 安全判斷」。讀完後，請用最後四個情境題練習寫出證據與下一步。
1｜從辦公大樓的分機開始理解
把電腦想成辦公大樓：IP 位址像總機號碼，Port（連接埠）像分機，服務程式像接聽人員，防火牆像限制來電的門禁。比喻幫助我們分工；實際入口必須用 IP、傳輸協定與 Port 一起描述。

rows: 編號不能證明實際服務
TCP 成功不保證 TLS／網站正常
服務可能使用其他編號

sourceBody.text: 例如 192.0.2.10:443/TCP 與 192.0.2.10:443/UDP 是兩個入口。TCP 443 可能提供 HTTPS；UDP 443 可能提供 HTTP/3（使用 QUIC）。TCP 443 open 不代表 UDP 443 也 open，反過來亦然。
192.0.2.10 與本課其他 192.0.2.x 位址是文件範例，不表示有真實服務。完整的查核問題是：「從哪裡、何時、用什麼協定與方法，探測哪個入口，收到什麼？」實作限定自己的本機或另行核准的設備。
2｜先把三個核心狀態分清楚
Nmap 是網路探索與安全稽核工具，會根據探測方法與回應分類。想像打分機：有人接受通話、有人明確回覆不受理，或來電受限制而無法確認是否有人接聽。三種情況得到的證據不同。

rows: 該入口接受起始連線請求；服務功能與安全性另查
工具判為關閉；核對服務監聽及回覆是否來自中間設備
重試後無回覆或特定 ICMP 錯誤
此方法無法確認開放或關閉；核對政策、路徑與日誌

sourceBody.text: open 不等於有漏洞，也不保證應用程式正常。TCP 443 接受請求後，仍可能遇到 TLS 憑證、HTTP 錯誤、登入或權限問題。確認服務與版本可接到 M03-05，弱點分析則需要另外的證據。
closed 通常正是因為收到明確回應才成立，不能解讀成整台電腦關機或網路完全不通。例如 TCP 8443 closed，可能是服務未啟動、未監聽該埠、只綁定其他介面，也可能是防火牆或中間設備產生 RST。工具分類不等於已證明目標主機內部狀態。
filtered 的現象是缺少可確認開放／關閉的回應，或收到符合規則的錯誤。防火牆、路由器規則、主機防火牆是常見原因；封包遺失、設備或路徑異常也會影響探測。不能單憑 filtered 指認某台防火牆。
同一 Port 從不同位置可呈現不同狀態。把結果寫成「從管理網段測得 TCP 443 open」，會比「443 開著」更容易重現。[Nmap：六種狀態](https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-basics.html)

sourceBody.text: 3｜TCP SYN 掃描：用回應讀懂三種狀態
TCP 一般新連線的三向交握是：用戶端送 SYN，伺服器回 SYN/ACK，用戶端回 ACK。SYN（Synchronize）同步初始序號；ACK（Acknowledgment）確認收到資訊；RST（Reset）重設連線或連線嘗試。這些是 TCP 標頭中的控制旗標。

一般 TCP 連線：掃描端 → SYN → 目標
              掃描端 ← SYN/ACK ← 目標
              掃描端 → ACK → 目標
SYN 掃描開放情境：收到 SYN/ACK 後，由掃描端以 RST 結束嘗試
Connect 掃描請作業系統完成連線。SYN 掃描收到 SYN/ACK 就有接受起始請求的證據，不必再送最後 ACK。Half-open（半開式）描述未完成一般交握，並非 Port 開了一半；也不表示掃描無法被偵測。
對 SYN 回 RST，與掃描端收到 SYN/ACK 後主動送 RST，方向及用途不同。前者是 closed 的典型依據，後者是在 open 探測情境結束嘗試。記錄時要保留來源、目的及前後封包。
ICMP（網際網路控制訊息協定）用來傳遞網路錯誤等資訊。只有符合這種方法規則的 Type／Code 才對應 filtered；不能把所有 ICMP 都當成過濾。上表數字是 IPv4，不套用到 ICMPv6。[Nmap：SYN 判讀](https://nmap.org/book/synscan.html)
例如：「收到 TCP RST」放在觀察欄；「Nmap 分類為 closed」放在判讀欄；「查服務監聽與防火牆日誌」放在下一步。封包回應與工具分類分開，其他人才能核對推論。

sourceBody.text: 4｜UDP 的沉默，要保留兩個可能方向
UDP 直接傳送資料報，沒有 TCP 三向交握。可以把它想成寄送申請單：對方可能收到，卻因格式不符而不回覆；也可能是申請單或回信在路上被擋住、遺失。
因此，UDP 沒回應時不能直接判為 closed。open|filtered 的「|」表示「或」：目前無法區分開放但沉默與受到過濾，不是半開放，也不是已證明兩種狀態同時存在。

rows: 核對回覆內容及服務設定
核對接收端點與錯誤來源
補服務格式查詢、監聽設定與日誌

sourceBody.text: ICMP Port Unreachable 表示連接埠無法到達。分析時核對回報來源及其中引用的原始探測，避免把不相關錯誤算入結果。主機也可能對 ICMP 錯誤限速，讓掃描端需要等待與重試。
假設有以下示意輸出：

PORT    STATE          SERVICE
53/udp  open|filtered  domain
53/udp 是 UDP 53；open|filtered 保留不確定性；未做服務辨識時，domain 通常只是常見 Port 名稱，不能單靠這一欄證明 DNS 正在執行。
若設備由你管理或已核准測試，可用有效的 DNS 查詢增加證據：
dig @192.0.2.53 example.com A
192.0.2.53 是文件位址，操作時換成已核准的 DNS 伺服器。收到有效 DNS 回應可支持服務有回應該次查詢；dig 在部分情況會改用 TCP，因此要確認輸出或封包確實使用 UDP，才將它算作 UDP 證據。
也可在核准範圍使用服務版本探測。以下是指令格式，尖括號是待替換的目標，不能直接貼入 shell：
sudo nmap -sU -sV -p 53 --reason <authorized-host>
-sU 選 UDP，-sV 嘗試辨識服務，-p 53 限定埠，--reason 顯示判定理由。服務探測可能取得回應而縮小不確定性，但不保證消除所有 open|filtered。[Nmap：UDP](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-udp-scan.html)

sourceBody.text: 5｜另外兩個標籤：知道它在回答哪個問題
ACK Scan（-sA）送出帶 ACK 旗標的探測，主要觀察這類封包的過濾行為。SYN Scan 問入口是否接受新的連線，兩者的判讀規則不同。

掃描端 → 目標／路徑：ACK
掃描端 ← 目標／路徑：RST
ACK Scan 分類：unfiltered

unfiltered 表示該 ACK 探測可取得回應，仍未分清 open 或 closed。未受該探測所見過濾的系統，開放與關閉的 Port 都可能對 ACK 回 RST。若重試後無回覆或收到特定 ICMP 錯誤，ACK Scan 會分類 filtered。要確認是否接受新連線，再用核准的 SYN 或 Connect 掃描。[Nmap：ACK Scan](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-ack-scan.html)
closed|filtered 則是 IP ID Idle Scan（閒置掃描）使用的候選分類，表示該方法無法區分關閉與過濾。本課先理解標籤，不延伸到閒置掃描操作。

rows: 有接受相應通訊的證據
所有功能正常或存在漏洞
整台主機離線，或已查清所有拒絕原因
此方法無法確認入口開放
一定由某台防火牆造成
服務一定接受新的 TCP 連線

sourceBody.text: 例如同樣收到 RST：SYN 掃描通常讀成 closed，ACK 掃描讀成 unfiltered。先問工具送了什麼，再讀它收到什麼。[Nmap：狀態定義](https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-basics.html)
6｜讀一次完整的合成案例
假設驗收伺服器 192.0.2.10：TCP 443 是管理介面，只允許管理網段；TCP 8443 是目前不應啟用的備用入口；UDP 53 預計提供 DNS。核准從管理網段與一般網段觀察。以下都是合成紀錄，不是實測結果。

rows: 符合接受起始請求的初步預期；續查 TLS、登入與權限
核對限制規則與同時段日誌，排除非預期路徑故障
對照目前不應啟用的部署計畫
用有效 DNS 查詢、監聽設定及日誌補證據

sourceBody.text: 443 的兩個結果可以同時正確，因為來源、路徑與存取條件不同。SYN/ACK 只證明起始請求得到接受回應；案例沒有完成三向交握，不能直接寫成已建立完整 TCP 連線。
若 8443 原本應該提供服務，closed 就需要調查：程式是否啟動、埠號是否正確、綁定在哪個位址、是否有中間設備回 RST。Ubuntu 可查看 TCP 監聽端點：

ss -lnt
sudo ss -lntp
第一行可查看監聽狀態；第二行在具備權限時加入程序資訊。127.0.0.1:8443 表示只監聽本機 Loopback（迴環）位址，其他電腦通常不能經伺服器外部 IP 直接連到它。0.0.0.0:8443 表示監聽所有本機 IPv4 位址，但遠端是否可達仍取決於路由、防火牆等條件；它也不自動代表 IPv6。
UDP 53 的下一步是確認 DNS 是否啟動、是否有 UDP 監聽、查詢是否到達服務，以及去回程是否遭到阻擋。程式有監聽與遠端能存取，是兩個要分別驗證的問題。
7｜把掃描報告寫成別人能重現的紀錄

rows: Nmap 依 SYN 掃描規則記為 open
核對服務用途、TLS、權限與允許來源

sourceBody.text: 在自己的 Ubuntu 上，可先確認工具版本，再只檢查本機三個 TCP 埠：

nmap --version
nmap -sT -p 22,80,443 --reason 127.0.0.1
-sT 是 TCP Connect，-p 22,80,443 限定範圍，--reason 顯示理由，127.0.0.1 連回自己的電腦。未啟動服務的埠可能 closed；實際結果取決於本機設定。這不經過外部網路，不能用來驗收外部防火牆；本機防火牆仍可能影響回應。
若有原始封包權限，可比較 SYN 掃描：
sudo nmap -sS -p 22,80,443 --reason 127.0.0.1
先記下方法與結果，再用核准的 Wireshark 或 tcpdump 擷取確認交握差異。需要停止時按 Ctrl+C。本練習不啟動服務、不改防火牆；結束擷取並妥善保管或移除自行產生的紀錄即可，不需關閉原有服務。
以下是 SYN 掃描的簡化示例，非實測輸出：

PORT      STATE   SERVICE    REASON
443/tcp   open    https      syn-ack
8443/tcp  closed  https-alt  reset
可讀成「TCP 443 因收到 SYN/ACK，被分類為 open」。Connect 的理由文字可能是 conn-accepted 或 conn-refused，會依方法及版本而異；不能把 SYN 範例當作 -sT 固定輸出。--reason 提供工具理由，精確封包序列仍要由擷取紀錄核對。[Nmap：輸出選項](https://nmap.org/book/man-output.html)

rows: 目標 IP、協定、Port、授權用途
來源網段、時間與時區、工具版本、選項、等待與重試
封包、系統錯誤、無回應或原始輸出
狀態與理由，連回所用方法
預期差異、設定與日誌、負責人、複測安排

sourceBody.text: 例如時間記成 2026-11-03 10:30 UTC+08:00（示例），讓管理者能定位同時段日誌。紀錄可寫：「從管理網段，以 SYN 探測 TCP 443，收到 SYN/ACK，記為 open；依變更單核對服務及來源政策。」

sourceBody.text: 8｜防護怎麼做，驗收就怎麼看
open 本身無法回答安全或不安全。公開 HTTPS 與內部資料庫本來就有不同的可存取需求。防護目標是讓入口與業務用途、信任範圍一致。

rows: 確認用途、維護人與更新安排；依核准變更停用不必要服務
設定必要來源與用途，結合身分驗證、加密及應用權限
從允許及限制位置分別測試，對照設定與日誌

sourceBody.text: 以一台合成的 AI 推論伺服器為例：HTTPS 443 提供給核准使用者，SSH 22 限管理網段，PostgreSQL 5432 只供指定應用主機，Prometheus 9090 限監控網段。這是政策範例，不是對真實設備的設定建議；Port 與來源 IP 不能取代身分驗證及權限控制。
防火牆、安全群組與網路 ACL（存取控制清單）可限制流量。管理網段看到 SSH open、一般網段看到 filtered，是政策可能生效的線索；仍要對照規則、實際連線與日誌，排除路由故障等其他原因。這也銜接 M12 的網路防護觀念。
9｜小檢核：把狀態翻成下一步
知識路線是「選方法 → 收集 TCP／UDP／ICMP 或等待結果 → 分類 → 記錄 → 查設定 → 對照政策」。六種狀態是依方法產生的不同結果，不是一定要依序經過的階段。
常見誤解有三個：filtered 不足以指認防火牆；open 不足以證明漏洞；closed 與 filtered 不能互換。狀態幫助選下一步，安全判斷需要用途與政策。
問題一：SYN 掃描 TCP 443 收到 RST。A. 通常是什麼狀態？B. 能據此認定伺服器關機嗎？C. 若預期有 HTTPS，接著查什麼？
問題二：DNS Server 的 UDP 53 顯示 open|filtered。A. DNS 一定啟動嗎？B. 防火牆一定阻擋嗎？C. 如何補證據？
問題三：SSH 22 從管理網段看 open，一般網段看 filtered。A. 是否矛盾？B. 若政策只允許管理網段，是否符合初步預期？C. 完整驗收還缺什麼？
問題四：ACK Scan 顯示 unfiltered。A. 能直接判成 open 嗎？B. 這種方法主要檢查什麼？C. 要確認接受新 TCP 連線，改用什麼方法？
另保留原有紀錄練習：若報告只有「UDP 53 open|filtered」，請補至少四項資訊，讓下一位工程師能接續查核。參考答案在文末收合區；它們不代表讀者已完成測驗。
10｜概念問答：把容易混淆的地方接起來
10.1｜open 就能直接使用服務嗎？
open 提供相應通訊入口的證據，還可能遇到 TLS、應用錯誤、登入或權限限制。TCP 443 的探測成功與 HTTPS 正常運作分開驗證。
10.2｜同一個 Port，為什麼不同人看到不同結果？
來源網段、路徑、NAT／代理、存取政策、時間及方法都可能不同。先確認實際測到同一入口，再比較管理者與一般使用者的結果；若符合設計，兩者可以同時正確。
10.3｜UDP 沉默為什麼不能直接算 closed？
服務可能只回覆特定格式，也可能收到但不需要回覆；路徑丟棄也會造成沉默。缺少可區分的證據時，保留 open|filtered，再補有效查詢與設備紀錄。
10.4｜unfiltered 與 open 差在哪裡？
ACK Scan 的 unfiltered 只說這類探測取得回應，未確定服務接受新連線。open 則是另一種方法取得接受相應通訊的特徵。同樣收到 RST，SYN 與 ACK 掃描也必須按原本送出的探測分別解讀。
10.5｜看到 filtered，調查從哪裡開始？
先對照預期來源政策，再查來源位置、路由、防火牆規則、同時段日誌與服務監聽。必要時從另一個核准位置複測。目標是釐清原因、驗證設計，並非把所有結果都改成 open。
把「位置、方法、回應、狀態、下一步」寫在同一筆紀錄裡。下一單元 M03-05 會進一步查服務版本與橫幅，讓開放入口背後的程式有更多可核對證據。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：1. SYN 掃描收到 RST
paragraphs: A. 通常分類為 closed。B. 不能因此認定伺服器關機；掃描端取得了明確回覆，還需查明回覆來自主機或中間設備。C. 核對 HTTPS 服務是否啟動、實際監聽埠與綁定位址，並查防火牆規則與同時段日誌。保留原始方法、來源及 RST。作為對照，UDP 重試後無回覆通常保留 open|filtered。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：2. UDP 53 的兩個候選
paragraphs: A. 不能確認 DNS 一定啟動。B. 也不能確認一定是防火牆阻擋。服務可能忽略不符合格式的資料，也可能有去回程過濾、遺失或錯誤回報限速。C. 在核准範圍發出有效 DNS 查詢，確認實際使用 UDP，對照回覆、監聽設定、DNS 與防火牆日誌。-sV 可增加辨識機會，仍可能留下不確定性。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：3. 管理與一般網段
paragraphs: A. 不矛盾，結果描述不同來源與路徑。B. 若政策只允許管理網段，這符合初步預期。C. 還需核對兩次是否為同一入口、時間與方法，並比對服務綁定、防火牆允許／拒絕規則及同時段日誌；以實際連線與應用權限確認可用範圍。單次 filtered 不能證明所有限制都生效。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：4. ACK Scan 的 unfiltered
paragraphs: A. 不能直接判為 open。B. ACK Scan 主要觀察這類探測的過濾行為，開放或關閉的入口都可能回 RST。C. 在核准範圍使用 SYN 或 TCP Connect 掃描，觀察是否接受新連線，再對照監聽設定；應用程式功能需要另行查核。

sourceBody.summary: 參考解答：原有練習：補齊查核紀錄
paragraphs: 至少補四項，例如目標 IP 與授權用途、來源網段、時間與時區、UDP 掃描方式與工具版本、等待／重試、酬載格式、原始輸出與理由。保留 UDP 53 的協定與埠號，補服務／DNS／防火牆紀錄、下一步核准查詢與負責人，讓別人能重現並接續處理。

en.summary: Connect Open, Closed, Filtered and other states to observation location, method and response, then choose the next check.

sourceBody.text: CEH M03-04 | Open, Closed and Filtered: interpret responses as port states

Port scanning sends probes and interprets responses to describe an endpoint at that time. Start with three ideas: open has evidence of accepting communication; closed has an explicit closed-port response; filtered means this probe cannot establish whether the endpoint is open. The scanning method determines the actual classification.

M03-01 introduced IP, TCP, UDP and ports; M03-02 explored hosts, ICMP and ARP; M03-03 compared Connect, SYN and UDP scans. This lesson connects method → response → state → verification → security judgment. Use the four scenarios at the end to practice stating evidence and a next step.
1 | Start with an office extension

Imagine a computer as an office building: an IP address resembles a switchboard number, a port an extension, a service the person answering, and a firewall a gate controlling calls. This analogy separates responsibilities; an actual endpoint requires an IP address, transport protocol and port together.

rows: A number does not identify the actual service
TCP success does not establish TLS/website health
A service can use another number

sourceBody.text: 192.0.2.10:443/TCP and 192.0.2.10:443/UDP are separate endpoints. TCP 443 may provide HTTPS; UDP 443 may provide HTTP/3 over QUIC. Open TCP 443 does not establish open UDP 443, or vice versa.

192.0.2.10 and the other 192.0.2.x addresses are documentation examples, not evidence of real services. Ask the full question: “From where, when, using which protocol and method, against which endpoint, and with what response?” Practical work is restricted to your own local machine or separately approved devices.
2 | Separate the three core states

Nmap is a network discovery and security auditing tool that classifies responses according to the probe method. An extension might accept a call, explicitly refuse it, or remain unobservable because calls are restricted. Those situations supply different evidence.

headers: What it supports and what remains
rows: The endpoint accepts an opening request; functionality and security need separate checks
The tool classifies it as closed; verify listeners and whether an intermediary generated the reply
No response after retries or certain ICMP errors
This method cannot distinguish open from closed; check policy, path and logs

sourceBody.text: Open does not establish a vulnerability or a working application. After TCP 443 accepts a request, TLS certificates, HTTP errors, login or permissions can still prevent use. Service/version identification connects to M03-05; vulnerability analysis needs additional evidence.

Closed usually depends on receiving an explicit response. It does not mean the entire computer is powered off or the network is wholly unreachable. TCP 8443 may be closed because a service is stopped, uses another port or binds another interface; a firewall or intermediary may also generate RST. The tool's classification does not independently establish the host's internal state.

Filtered describes missing decisive open/closed evidence or an error matching the method's rules. Dedicated firewalls, router rules and host firewalls are common causes; packet loss, device failures and path problems also affect probes. Filtered alone cannot identify a particular firewall.

The same port can appear different from different positions. “TCP 443 was open from the management network” is easier to reproduce than “443 is open.” [Nmap: six states](https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-basics.html)

sourceBody.text: 3 | TCP SYN scanning: interpret the response

An ordinary new TCP connection uses a three-way handshake: client SYN, server SYN/ACK, client ACK. SYN (Synchronize) synchronizes initial sequence numbers; ACK (Acknowledgment) confirms received information; RST (Reset) resets a connection or attempt. These are control flags in the TCP header.

Ordinary TCP: scanner → SYN → target
              scanner ← SYN/ACK ← target
              scanner → ACK → target
Open SYN scan: after SYN/ACK, the scanner side ends the attempt with RST

Connect delegates connection establishment to the OS. SYN scanning already has evidence of an accepted opening request after SYN/ACK, without sending the final ACK. Half-open describes an incomplete ordinary handshake, not a port being halfway open; it also does not imply undetectability.

RST in response to SYN differs in direction and purpose from a scanner-side reset after SYN/ACK. The former is typical closed evidence; the latter ends an open-port probe. Retain source, destination and surrounding packets.

ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) conveys network errors and other control information. Only type/code values matching this method's rules map to filtered; not every ICMP message means filtering. The table uses IPv4 values, not ICMPv6 values. [Nmap: SYN interpretation](https://nmap.org/book/synscan.html)

Put “received TCP RST” in the observation field, “Nmap classified closed” in the interpretation field, and “check listeners and firewall logs” in the next-step field. Separating responses from classifications makes the reasoning inspectable.

sourceBody.text: 4 | UDP silence leaves two possibilities

UDP sends datagrams without a TCP handshake. Think of sending an application form: the recipient might receive but ignore an invalid format, or the form or reply might be blocked or lost along the way.

Silence therefore does not directly establish closed. The “|” in open|filtered means “or”: an open silent service and filtering remain indistinguishable. It is neither half-open nor proof of both states at once.

rows: Verify response content and service settings
Verify the receiver and error source
Add valid service queries, listener settings and logs

sourceBody.text: ICMP Port Unreachable reports an unreachable destination port. Match the reporting source and quoted original probe so unrelated errors do not enter the result. Hosts can also rate-limit ICMP errors, making the scanner wait and retry.
Consider this illustrative output:

PORT    STATE          SERVICE
53/udp  open|filtered  domain
53/udp means UDP 53; open|filtered preserves uncertainty. Without service detection, domain is usually a conventional port label and does not establish that DNS is running.
For a device you manage or are authorized to test, a valid DNS query can add evidence:
dig @192.0.2.53 example.com A

192.0.2.53 is a documentation address; replace it with an approved DNS server for actual use. A valid DNS response supports that service answering this query. dig can switch to TCP in some circumstances, so verify the output or capture actually used UDP before counting it as UDP evidence.
Service/version detection can also be used within the approved scope. This is command syntax: replace the angle-bracket target instead of pasting it literally into a shell.
sudo nmap -sU -sV -p 53 --reason <authorized-host>

-sU selects UDP, -sV attempts service identification, -p 53 restricts the port, and --reason displays classification reasons. Service probes can elicit replies and reduce uncertainty, but cannot guarantee resolution of every open|filtered result. [Nmap: UDP](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-udp-scan.html)

sourceBody.text: 5 | Two more labels: identify the question being asked
ACK Scan (-sA) sends probes with the ACK flag to observe filtering of that traffic. SYN Scan asks whether an endpoint accepts a new connection. The interpretation rules differ.

Scanner → target/path: ACK
Scanner ← target/path: RST
ACK Scan classification: unfiltered

Unfiltered means this ACK probe obtained a response, without distinguishing open from closed. In unfiltered systems, both open and closed ports can return RST to ACK. No response after retries or certain ICMP errors maps to filtered. Use an approved SYN or Connect scan to check acceptance of new connections. [Nmap: ACK Scan](https://nmap.org/book/scan-methods-ack-scan.html)
Closed|filtered is the candidate classification used by IP ID Idle Scan when it cannot distinguish closure from filtering. This lesson explains the label without expanding into idle-scan operations.

rows: Every function works, or a vulnerability exists
The whole host is offline, or every refusal cause is known
A particular firewall must be responsible
An ACK probe obtained a response
The service accepts new TCP connections

sourceBody.text: The same RST typically means closed for SYN scanning and unfiltered for ACK scanning. Ask what was sent before interpreting what came back. [Nmap: state definitions](https://nmap.org/book/man-port-scanning-basics.html)
6 | Work through a synthetic acceptance case

Suppose server 192.0.2.10 has a management interface on TCP 443, allowed only from the management network; TCP 8443 is a spare endpoint that should currently be disabled; UDP 53 should provide DNS. Observation is approved from management and ordinary networks. These are synthetic records, not measured results.

rows: Opening acceptance matches initial expectations; check TLS, login and permissions
Match restriction rules and contemporaneous logs; exclude unintended path failure
Compare with the plan to leave it disabled
Add valid DNS queries, listener settings and logs

sourceBody.text: Both TCP 443 results can hold because sources, paths and access conditions differ. SYN/ACK establishes acceptance of the opening request. This case did not complete the handshake, so it does not establish a completed TCP connection.

If TCP 8443 should have a service, investigate whether the program started, selected the correct port, bound the intended address, or whether an intermediary returned RST. On Ubuntu, inspect TCP listeners with:

ss -lnt
sudo ss -lntp

The first command displays listeners; the second adds process information when permitted. 127.0.0.1:8443 listens only on loopback, so other computers generally cannot directly reach that listener via the server's external IP. 0.0.0.0:8443 listens on all local IPv4 addresses, but remote reachability still depends on routing, firewalls and other conditions; it does not automatically include IPv6.

For UDP 53, check whether DNS started, a UDP listener exists, the query reached the service, and either direction was blocked. A program listening and a remote client being able to reach it are separate verification questions.
7 | Write a record another engineer can reproduce

rows: Nmap records open under SYN scan rules
Verify service purpose, TLS, permissions and allowed sources

sourceBody.text: On your own Ubuntu machine, check the tool version, then examine only three local TCP ports:

nmap --version
nmap -sT -p 22,80,443 --reason 127.0.0.1

-sT selects TCP Connect, -p 22,80,443 restricts scope, --reason displays reasons, and 127.0.0.1 connects to your own machine. Ports without services may be closed; results depend on local settings. This does not traverse the external network and cannot validate an external firewall. A local firewall can still affect replies.
With raw-packet privileges, compare a SYN scan:
sudo nmap -sS -p 22,80,443 --reason 127.0.0.1

Record the method and result, then use approved Wireshark or tcpdump capture to inspect handshake differences. Stop with Ctrl+C when needed. This exercise starts no service and changes no firewall rules. End any capture and retain or remove the records you created; do not stop existing services.
This is simplified SYN scan output, not a measured result:

PORT      STATE   SERVICE    REASON
443/tcp   open    https      syn-ack
8443/tcp  closed  https-alt  reset

Read it as “TCP 443 is classified open because SYN/ACK was received.” Connect reasons may instead be conn-accepted or conn-refused, depending on method and version. Do not treat SYN examples as fixed -sT output. --reason reports the tool's reason; packet capture is needed to verify the precise sequence. [Nmap: output options](https://nmap.org/book/man-output.html)

rows: Target IP, protocol, port, authorized purpose
Source network, time and timezone, tool version, options, waits and retries
Packets, system errors, silence or original output
State and reason tied to the method
Expected/actual difference, settings and logs, owner, retest plan

sourceBody.text: For example, record 2026-11-03 10:30 UTC+08:00 (illustrative) so administrators can locate matching logs. A record can say: “From management, SYN-probed TCP 443, received SYN/ACK, recorded open; verify service and source policy against the change request.”

sourceBody.text: 8 | Align protection with acceptance checks

Open alone cannot determine safe versus unsafe. Public HTTPS and an internal database have different access requirements. Protection aims to align exposed endpoints with business purpose and trust boundaries.

rows: Confirm purpose, owner and updates; disable unnecessary services through approved changes
Restrict necessary sources/purposes, with authentication, encryption and application permissions
Did the configuration achieve its purpose?
Test from allowed and restricted positions and compare settings/logs

sourceBody.text: In a synthetic AI inference server example, HTTPS 443 serves approved users, SSH 22 is restricted to management, PostgreSQL 5432 to designated application hosts, and Prometheus 9090 to monitoring. This illustrates policy, not a prescription for a real device. Ports and source IPs do not replace authentication or authorization.

Firewalls, security groups and network access control lists (ACLs) can restrict traffic. SSH appearing open from management and filtered elsewhere is an indication of possible policy effect. Compare rules, actual connections and logs to exclude causes such as routing failure. This connects to M12 network protection concepts.
9 | Checks: translate a state into a next step

Follow method → TCP/UDP/ICMP or waiting evidence → classification → record → configuration check → policy comparison. The six states are method-dependent outcomes, not stages that every scan traverses in order.

Three common errors are treating filtered as proof of a firewall, open as proof of a vulnerability, or closed and filtered as interchangeable. States guide follow-up; security judgments require purpose and policy.
Question one: A SYN scan of TCP 443 receives RST. A. What is the typical state? B. Does it establish that the server is powered off? C. If HTTPS was expected, what would you check next?
Question two: A DNS server's UDP 53 is open|filtered. A. Is DNS definitely running? B. Is a firewall definitely blocking it? C. How would you add evidence?

Question three: SSH 22 is open from management and filtered from an ordinary network. A. Are these contradictory? B. Does this match initial expectations if policy allows management only? C. What remains for full acceptance?
Question four: ACK Scan reports unfiltered. A. Can you directly call it open? B. What does this method mainly examine? C. Which method would check acceptance of new TCP connections?

Retain the original recording exercise as well: if a report says only “UDP 53 open|filtered,” add at least four fields so another engineer can continue. Reference answers are in the final disclosures; their publication does not establish learner completion.
10 | Concept questions: connect the distinctions
10.1 | Does open mean I can use the service?

Open supplies evidence about the corresponding communication endpoint. TLS, application errors, login and permissions can still prevent use. Verify TCP 443 probe success separately from working HTTPS.
10.2 | Why can people see different results for the same port?

Source networks, paths, NAT/proxies, access policies, time and methods can differ. Confirm the same actual endpoint before comparing management and ordinary-user observations. Both can be correct under the intended design.
10.3 | Why does UDP silence not establish closed?

A service may answer only particular formats or may receive without needing to reply; path drops also cause silence. Preserve open|filtered when evidence cannot distinguish these cases, then add valid queries and device records.
10.4 | How does unfiltered differ from open?

ACK Scan's unfiltered means this probe obtained a response, without establishing acceptance of new connections. Open reflects acceptance characteristics under an appropriate method. Interpret the same RST differently for SYN and ACK probes according to what was originally sent.
10.5 | Where should investigation of filtered begin?

Compare intended source policy, then inspect source position, routes, firewall rules, contemporaneous logs and listeners. If needed, retest from another approved position. The goal is to explain the observation and verify design, not to turn every result into open.
Keep position, method, response, state and next step in the same record. M03-05 next examines service versions and banners to gather more evidence about software behind an open endpoint.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 1. RST in response to SYN
paragraphs: A. Typically closed. B. It does not establish that the server is powered off; the scanner received an explicit reply, whose host or intermediary source still needs verification. C. Check whether HTTPS started, its actual listening port and bind address, firewall rules and contemporaneous logs. Retain the method, source and RST. By comparison, UDP silence after retries typically remains open|filtered.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 2. Two candidates for UDP 53
paragraphs: A. DNS is not definitely running. B. A blocking firewall is not established either. The service might ignore invalid content; request/reply filtering, loss or error rate limiting can also contribute. C. Send an authorized valid DNS query, confirm it actually uses UDP, and compare responses, listeners, DNS logs and firewall logs. -sV can improve identification but may leave uncertainty.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: 3. Management and ordinary networks
paragraphs: A. There is no contradiction: the results describe different sources and paths. B. They match initial expectations if policy allows only management. C. Confirm the same endpoint, time and method, and compare service binding, firewall allow/deny rules and contemporaneous logs. Use actual connections and application permissions to establish usable access. One filtered result does not prove every restriction works.

A. You cannot directly classify it as open. B. ACK scanning examines filtering of that probe; both open and closed endpoints can return RST. C. Use an approved SYN or TCP Connect scan to observe acceptance of new connections, then compare listeners. Application functionality requires a separate check.

sourceBody.summary: Reference answer: Retained exercise: complete the record
paragraphs: Add at least four items, such as target IP and authorized purpose, source network, time and timezone, UDP method and tool version, waits/retries, payload format, raw output and reasons. Retain UDP 53's protocol and port, and add service/DNS/firewall records, an approved next query and an owner so another engineer can reproduce and continue the work.
